$comment: Source -> dist/skills/ artifact mapping, applied in order by assemble.mjs (later entries layer onto earlier copies). Skills are flat siblings — clients discover <skills-dir>/<name>/SKILL.md one level deep. Regenerate with `node packages/mdk-skill/src/assemble.mjs`; never hand-edit dist/.

entries.note: Hand-authored suite content: router + mdk-worker-plugin, mdk-gateway-plugin, mdk-ui-component, mdk-deployment, mdk-site-sizing (full workflows). Regenerate it with `npm run generate:ui-registry` from the repo root; never hand-edit it. mdk-site-sizing/references/envelope.json is compiled from eval/profiles (or harness results) by skills/mdk-site-sizing/scripts/compile-envelope.mjs.
